preconditions.description: The to_currency parameter must be either 'USD' or 'EUR'.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(value, (int, float)) for value in values_list)
preconditions.description: Each value in the values_list must be an integer or a float.

postconditions.description: The length of the result list must be equal to the length of the values_list.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(formatted_value, str) for formatted_value in result)
postconditions.description: Each item in the result list must be a string.

postconditions.expression: all(formatted_value.endswith(to_currency) for formatted_value, to_currency in zip(result, [to_currency] * len(result)))
postconditions.description: Each formatted value must end with the specified currency type.
Each formatted value, without commas and dots, must represent a valid number.
